items.name: Caveman Cubing Lohja 2025
items.information: Welcome to the lowest elevation WCA competition 100 meters below ground! Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. The competition venue is in a mine accessible by a 22 second elevator ride. There are no toilets or drinking water in the venue, but the visitor center on the surface has both available. Temperature in the mine is 6-8 °C and very humid. The venue is a separate room heated to 20 °C. You will receive a helmet and wearing it is mandatory in the mine, but it can be removed once at the venue. Bring your own lunch and drinks. Tervetuloa maailman syvimpään WCA-kilpailuun 100 metriä maanpinnan alla! Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua. Kilpailupaikka sijaitsee kaivoksessa, johon pääsee 22 sekunnin hissikyydillä. Kilpailupaikalla ei ole vessoja tai juomavettä, mutta molempiin on pääsy maan pinnalla vierailijakeskuksessa. Lämpötila kaivoksessa on 6-8 °C ja ilmankosteus korkea. Kilpailupaikka on 20 °C lämmitetty erillinen tila. Saat lainaan kypärän, jonka käyttö kaivoksessa on pakollista. Voit riisua kypärän kisapaikalla. Tuo mukana omat eväät ja juomat.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

Não nos responsabilizamos por perda de cubos mágicos e outros pertences durante a competição; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar para a equipe de organização e delegados. - Ao se inscrever você está autorizando o uso de imagem para divulgações sobre o campeonato. Mesmo que a nossa competição seja formada por alguns competidores experientes, sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. Procure se divertir bastante! Tips: - Arrive at the competition venue at least 30 minutes before the event you will be participating in; - The cube you will be competing with must be in good condition; - By registering, you agree to assist as a judge, runner, or in any other role requested by a delegate; - You are responsible for your cube and your belongings, so take care of them. We are not responsible for the loss of magic cubes and other belongings during the competition; - If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask the organizing team and delegates. - By registering, you are authorizing the use of your image for publicity about the competition. Even though our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, we always have room for new cubers. Have fun!

items.information: # 🇺🇾 Límite de competidores: 40. * Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes. * Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución. * **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CervantesCubea2023#32184-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CervantesCubea2023#32185-competidores-nuevos-newcomers). * Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1). * Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles. * Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor descalificandolo de la ronda en cuestión, de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. * Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia. Ante cualquier duda, consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA. # 🇬🇧 Competitor limit: 40. * Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue. * This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age. * **NEW COMPETITORS**: You must read [Important](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CervantesCubea2023#32184-importante-read) and [New competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CervantesCubea2023#32185-competidores-nuevos-newcomers). * Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1). * Competitors must bring their own puzzles. * Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, as per regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations. * It is important to read all the information available in the competition's website. Feel free to contact the organizers or the WCA Delegates.

items.information: ### [FR] Il s'agit du tout premier championnat québécois organisé par [Speedcubing Canada](https://speedcubingcanada.org). 13 épreuves officielles de la WCA (toutes les épreuves sauf 4x4x4 à l'aveugle, 5x5x5 à l'aveugle ,3x3x3 Multi-Blind, et 3x3x3 Fewest Moves) seront organisées lors de cette compétition. **Les étudiants de l'ÉTS peuvent s'inscrire sans frais**. If you are an ETS student, write your email address ending with etsmtl.net in the registration comments and submit your registration **and do not pay the registration fees**. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Chiclayano Talent Is Here 2022

venue.name: Seminario Teológico Nazareno del Perú
venue.address: Urbanización Patazca, Lambayeque, Bernardo Alcedo 125, Chiclayo 14009

items.information: Los resultados de este torneo ingresarán a la base de datos y al ranking de la WCA, y quienes participen por primera vez adquirirán un perfil oficial. Por esa razón, todos los competidores deben conocer el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). El Seminario Teológico Nazareno del Perú, es una institución evangélica dedicada a la preparación de ministros cristianos, y nos está brindando gentilmente sus instalaciones para la realización del torneo, por lo tanto, se les pide un comportamiento adecuado al Instituto Religioso. Se nos está permitido usar el lugar de ceremonias donde se realizará el torneo, transitar por los espacios abietos, y usar los baños. Pero está prohibido entrar a las aulas, oficinas y demás instalaciones del local. ____ The results of this competition will enter the data base and WCA ranking, and the ones participating for the first time will acquire an official profile. For that reason, every competitor must know the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). The Nazarene Theological Seminary of Peru is an evangelical institution dedicated to the preparation of Christian ministers, and are giving us kindly their facilities for the realization of the tournament, therefore, it is asked to have an appropriate behavior to the Religious Institute. We are allowed to use the place of ceremonies where the tournament will take place, go through the open spaces, and use the bathrooms. But it's forbidden to enter classrooms, offices and any other of the facilities.

items.name: Chill Out Trondheim 2025
items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Chill Out Trondheim 2025! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 50kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025#51927-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Chill Out Trondheim 2025! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 50 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025#51927-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

venue.name: [Chilliwack Alliance Church](http://www.chilliwackalliance.bc.ca/)
venue.details: The competition will be located in the gym.

items.information: Speedcubing is coming to Chilliwack, the green heart of the Fraser Valley. This will be the first WCA competition in Chilliwack and we are so excited to host you in our community. We look forward to a full house of 80 competitors and your supports to enjoy a fun day of friendly cubing. There will be a concession inside the gym serving snacks and drinks such as chips, chocolate bars, granola bars, pop, juice, water and coffee. The concession will be CASH only. There is tons of free parking at the venue. We are looking for any volunteers (parents/siblings included) who have experience as scramblers, judges and runners. We ask those who are able/willing to volunteer in any of these important areas to please e-mail Jackie at jackierillera@shaw.ca. A judging tutorial will be provided prior to the start of the competition. We look forward to seeing you all on Saturday October 5, 2019.

Es un desafío más avanzado que armarlo normalmente - ⚠️ **No explicaremos cómo resolver el Cubo de Rubik desde cero, o cómo resolverlo más rápido** **POR FAVOR LEER LA PESTAÑA ["IMPORTANTE"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ClasesdeFMCBAI2026#74558-importante-important) PARA REALIZAR EL REGISTRO CORRECTAMENTE** --- 📚 Welcome to the first competition in Argentina featuring specialized classes! - 🧑‍🎓 We recommend that you know how to solve a Rubik's Cube before attending these classes - 🏫 Check out the list of topics and what to expect [IN THIS TAB](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ClasesdeFMCBAI2026#74559-temario-de-clases-lecture-topics) - ❗ FMC is competed in writing, not by speed. It is an advanced challenge compared to regular solving - ⚠️ **We will not be explaining how to solve the Rubik's Cube from scratch, or how to solve it faster** **PLEASE READ THE ["IMPORTANT"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ClasesdeFMCBAI2026#74558-importante-important) TAB IN ORDER TO REGISTER SUCCESSFULLY**

items.information: 🇧🇷 Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ClickClock2Brasilia2025/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista [este vídeo](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da modalidade em que vai competir. Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a ABRACM, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. --- 🇺🇸 Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ClickClock2Brasilia2025/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the event you're competing in is scheduled to begin. By registering, you authorize ABRACM, WCA, and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

items.name: Cloverdale Open 2022
items.information: We're excited to welcome new and experienced cubers to Cloverdale, B.C., for the Cloverdale Open 2022 cubing competition. It's been a little while since we've seen cubing competitions in B.C., and we're thrilled to be one of the teams bringing cubers back together again to compete, connect, and have fun! Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**. We'll be raising funds for the [Cloverdale Community Kitchen](https://www.mycck.ca), an organization that feeds the hungry, and provides care for individuals when they are struggling. Their vision is to help Cloverdale/Surrey/Langley be a healthy and caring community for everyone. 10% of registration fees will be donated to the Cloverdale Community Kitchen. Note: there is of course the possibility that we will need to increase safety precautions. **Please be aware that changes may be needed.** Email will be sent out to registered competitors about significant changes. We look forward to a full house of 60 competitors! Spectators can attend for free. Being mindful of space, we ask that no competitor brings more than 2 guests.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of its events.

We are excited to welcome you and want to share some essential tips for competitors and companions: - Your registration will be confirmed on the WCA website as soon as the payment is confirmed and the receipt is sent. For more information, visit the [Registration](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ColatinaAgilOpen2024/register) tab; - We recommend arriving at the competition venue at least 30 minutes before the start of the event you will participate in; - Make sure that the cube you will use in the competition is in good condition, as damaged cubes may not be accepted; - We are here to assist you! If you have any questions, feel free to ask; - If this is your first competition, watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU); - Before the competition, read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) to become familiar with the rules; - Have fun and make the most of the experience!

items.information: 🇧🇷 Bem-vindos ao segundo campeonato Colégio Salesiano Open, em Itajaí! Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba Inscrever. Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste vídeo.https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8 Favor ler o Regulamento da WCA antes da competição. Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para o feminino e para novatos na modalidade 'Cubo 3x3x3'. A premiação extra-oficial será feita de acordo com a classificação do competidor na competição. (não será definida pela primeira rodada) 🇺🇸 Welcome to the Second Colégio Salesiano Open, competition in Itajaí! Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the Register tab. If you have any problem with how to register, take a look at this video. https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8 Please read the WCA Regulations before the competition. We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards for women and for beginners in the '3x3x3 Cube' event. The unofficial awards will be given according to the competitor's position in the competition (It will not be based on the first round results.)

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

Cada décima decide, cada centésima define. 3 rondas de las categorías más rápidas. El reto más grande: **vencer al reloj**. ​ Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del **Municipo de San Andrés Cholula** y a la **Presidenta Municipal Guadalupe Cuautle Torres**. ​ Contrarreloj - San Andrés Cholula 2026 es una competencia oficial de la WCA por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/). ​ **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing, Team Puebla y el equipo organizador con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen. ##### English ​ **¡Welcome to Contrarreloj - San Andrés Cholula 2026!** ​ San Andrés Cholula becomes the battlefield of speed, where **you don’t compete against others… you compete against time**. Every tenth matters, every hundredth defines. 3 rounds of the fastest events. The greatest challenge: **beat the clock**. ​ This competition is made possible thanks to the support of the **Municipality of San Andrés Cholula** and **Municipal President Guadalupe Cuautle Torres**. ​ Contrarreloj - San Andrés Cholula 2026 is a WCA official competition, hence all participants should be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations). **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing, Team Puebla and the organization team for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image.

items.information: **ESPAÑOL** Este es el primer torneo patrocinado por y realizado con la ayuda de Black Horse Toys. Los resultados de este torneo ingresarán a la base de datos y al ranking de la WCA, y quienes participen por primera vez adquirirán un perfil oficial. Por esa razón, todos los competidores deben conocer el reglamento de la WCA. REGISTRO: El registro se considera completo cuando se ha completado el registro electrónico y se ha realizado el pago (precio y métodos de pago explicados en la sección de requisitos de registro). Cada competidor debe elegir los eventos en los que se va a inscribir cuidadosamente luego de revisar la pestaña “Horario" (Schedule). Prestar atención a los formatos de cada ronda y a sus respectivos cortes y límites detallados en la pestaña “Categorías” (Events). Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID. *Los competidores que vengan de fuera de Lima deberán comunicarse y coordinar la forma de pago directamente con el organizador El registro permanecerá abierto hasta el viernes 31 de mayo o hasta que se alcance el límite de competidores. **ENGLISH** This is the first competition sponsored by Black Horse Toys store. The results of this competition will be listed on the WCA world rankings and new competitors will get an official WCA profile. For that reason, each competitor must be familiar with and understand the WCA Regulations before the competition. REGISTRATION: A register is considered complete when electronic registration has been completed and payment has been made (registration fees and payment methods are detailed at Registration requirements section). Each competitor must carefully choose the events in which he/she will participate after having seen the Schedule tab. Please pay attention to the formats of each round and its respective time limits and cutoffs detailed at the Events tab. It is important to carefully write your name, birth date, and other information properly. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted. If this is your second competition, you must have already claimed your WCA ID. *Competitors who come from outside Lima will have to contact the organizer in order to coordinate the payment method. Registration will stay opened till May 31 or till competitor limit is reached.

Check the schedule to see if the events at that time will be in the second floor ballroom, first floor alumni lounge, or ground floor commons. items.information: This is the fourth Copper Country Cubing competition, and we're looking forward to welcoming you to the Michigan Upper Peninsula! It's been a long time since anyone has been able to compete, so this event features two long events on Saturday evening and the more common NxN events on Sunday. We plan to host another competition this Fall with more of the non-NxN puzzles, so look out for it! As this competition takes place on the Michigan Technology University campus, it is subject to Michigan state laws, University campus policies, and WCA policies. We will monitor all of these sources for any changes to safety protocols and requirements. Please note that if community or regional health problems surface again or severely worsen, the competition may be forced to cancel. There is a 40 person Competitor Limit for this competition. Please sign up early to ensure a spot, and please read the "Waiting List" tab for additional information on registration for the competition. If the competition is running ahead of schedule and has enough competitors we would love to add an additional round to 3BLD, 3OH, and/or 6x6. Additionally, please note that the rounds are scheduled with more time than usual to account for stationary groups and sanitation time. **YOU MUST READ THE COVID SAFETY TAB PRIOR TO REGISTERING.**

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa0Y3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--da1436f51b6bdf99f61924b5ef7f58cd5d26107f/Coralito%20(1).png) ###### Español ¡Bienvenidos al Coralito Bahía De Banderas 2024, la tercera competencia oficial en el hermoso estado de Nayarit y primera en el municipio de Bahía de Banderas!. Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de La Cruz de Huanacaxtle los días 9 y 10 de noviembre de 2024. El Coralito Bahía De Banderas 2024 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de modalidades y categorías. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan. Esta competencia es organizada por el Team Nayarit y la comunidad Vallarta Speed. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. ###### English Welcome to Coralito Bahía De Banderas 2024, the third official competition in the beautiful state of Nayarit and the first one in the municipality of Bahía de Banderas! This exciting and fast-paced event will take place in the city of La Cruz de Huanacaxtle on November 9th and 10th, 2024. The Coralito Bahía De Banderas will bring together cubers from all over the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events and categories. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned pro, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun. This competition is organized by Team Nayarit and the Vallarta Speed community. This competition is recognized as a World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA1NzMzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--15740010cf766262637c38629cab00fad9ef50e2/1000228331.png) ###### Español Coralito Bahia de Banderas esta de vuelta! Coralito Bahía de Banderas regresa para celebrar su **segunda edición**, retomando el lugar donde comenzó todo. Hace dos años, este evento marcó un momento especial al convertirse en la **primera competencia de la WCA realizada en Bahía de Banderas**, reuniendo por primera vez a speedcubers y aficionados en una misma sede. Esta segunda edición busca volver a reunir a la comunidad del cubing para compartir la emoción de competir, mejorar tiempos, conocer nuevos competidores y, sobre todo, disfrutar de la pasión por los cubos Rubik. Esta competencia es organizada por la comunidad **Vallarta Speed**. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. ##### AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ ###### English Coralito Bahía de Banderas is back! Coralito Bahía de Banderas returns for its **second edition**, going back to the place where it all began. Two years ago, this event marked a special moment by becoming the **first WCA competition ever held in Bahía de Banderas**, bringing speedcubers and enthusiasts together at the same venue for the first time. This second edition aims to bring the cubing community together once again to share the excitement of competing, improving times, meeting new competitors, and, above all, enjoying the passion for Rubik’s Cubes. This competition is organized by the **Vallarta Speed community**. This competition is recognized as a World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. ##### NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information: ## Estimados competidores debido al incremento de casos Covid-19 la competencia para el 23 de enero será cancelada, ésta será reprogramada para Marzo, lamentamos el inconveniente que pueda ocasionar el cambio, favor coordinar con los organizadores la devolución del dinero si no puede participar en marzo. **Costa Rica Regresa 2022** será la primera competencia oficial despues de la pandemia en el país. Nuestra prioridad es garantizar la seguridad y el bienestar de nuestros competidores y organizadores durante el desarrollo de la competencia de speedcubing. Por este motivo, es necesario cumplir con todos los protocolos establecidos por el gobierno y las autoridades sanitarias de Costa Rica y por la WCA. Por tal motivo se tomará la temperatura a la entrada de la competencia. El uso de mascarilla es obligatorio en todo momento dentro de la competencia. Se solicitará carné de vacunación a los mayores de 12 años. Solo se permitirá un acompañante por persona. Cada competidor deberá llevar su propio lapicero. Se recomienda llevar más de una mascarilla en caso de ser necesario o bien para hacer un recambio. **.....................English version...................** ## Due to the increase in Covid-19 cases, the competition for January 23 will be canceled, it will be rescheduled for March. Costa Rica Regresa 2022 will be the first official competition after the pandemic in the country. Our priority is to ensure the safety and well-being of our competitors and staff during the development of the speedcubing competition. For this reason, it is necessary to comply with all the protocols established by the government and health authorities of Costa Rica and by the WCA. For this reason, the temperature will be taken at the entrance of the competition. The use of a mask is mandatory at all times within the competition. Vaccination card will be requested from those over 12 years of age. We will only allow one companion per person. Each competitor must bring their own pen. We reccomend bringing more than one face mask.

items.information: # Première Compétition Officielle de Speedcubing en Côte d’Ivoire! Un moment historique! Rejoignez-nous le **samedi 19 avril** pour la toute première compétition officielle WCA en **Côte d’Ivoire**! Que vous soyez un compétiteur expérimenté ou un nouveau venu dans le monde du speedcubing, c’est l’occasion parfaite de participer à cet événement unique. Quatre épreuves officielles sont au programme : **3x3**, **2x2**, **Pyraminx** et **3x3 à une main**. Vous pouvez choisir de participer à l'une ou à toutes! **Première compétition WCA?** Pas de souci! Un **tutoriel pour les débutants** vous expliquera tout ce qu’il faut savoir sur la compétition et l’arbitrage. N’oubliez pas d’apporter une **pièce d’identité** pour l’inscription. Ne manquez pas cette occasion historique - venez résoudre, concourir et faire partie de la communauté grandissante du speedcubing en Côte d’Ivoire! # Ivory Coast’s First-Ever Official WCA Competition! History is being made! Join us on **Saturday, April 19th**, for the first-ever WCA speedcubing competition in **Ivory Coast**! Whether you're a seasoned competitor or brand new to cubing, this is your chance to be part of something special. We'll be holding four official events, including **3x3**, **2x2**, **Pyraminx**, and **One-Handed** - compete in any or all of them! **New to WCA competitions?** No worries! We’ll have a **newcomer tutorial** to guide you through competing and judging. Just bring a form of ID for registration, and get ready to experience the thrill of official speedcubing. Don’t miss this historic event - come solve, compete, and be part of Ivory Coast’s growing cubing community!

items.information: # Deuxième Compétition Officielle de Speedcubing en Côte d’Ivoire! L’aventure continue ! Après une première compétition en 2025, nous sommes ravis de vous accueillir pour la **deuxième compétition officielle WCA en Côte d’Ivoire**, qui aura lieu le **samedi 4 juillet** ! Que vous ayez déjà participé à une compétition ou que vous découvriez tout juste le speedcubing, cette compétition est faite pour vous. Plusieurs épreuves officielles seront au programme : **2x2**, **3x3**, **4x4**, **5x5**, **3x3 à une main**, **Skewb** et **Pyraminx**. Vous pouvez participer à celles que vous souhaitez ! **Première compétition WCA ?** Aucun problème ! Un **tutoriel pour les débutants** sera proposé pour vous expliquer le déroulement, les règles et l’arbitrage. Pensez simplement à apporter une **pièce d’identité** pour l’inscription. Rejoignez-nous pour continuer à faire grandir la communauté du speedcubing en Côte d’Ivoire — venez résoudre, concourir et partager ce moment avec nous ! --- # Ivory Coast’s Second Official WCA Competition! The journey continues! After a first competition in 2025, we are excited to welcome you to the **second official WCA competition in Ivory Coast**, taking place on **Saturday, July 4th**! Whether you have already competed before or are just discovering speedcubing, this competition is for you. Several official events will be held: **2x2**, **3x3**, **4x4**, **5x5**, **3x3 One-Handed**, **Skewb**, and **Pyraminx**. Feel free to compete in any or all of them! **First WCA competition?** No worries! A **newcomer tutorial** will be available to guide you through the competition format, rules, and judging. Just remember to bring a valid **ID** for registration. Come and be part of the growing speedcubing community in Ivory Coast — solve, compete, and enjoy the experience together!

items.information: ### Deutsch Herzlich willkommen zur Cottbuser Cubing Competition! Wir freuen uns sehr, euch alle zur ersten offiziellen Speedcubing-Competition in der Lausitz begrüßen zu dürfen! Diese Premiere ist nicht nur ein sportliches Event, sondern auch ein Schritt, die Cubing-Community in Brandenburg weiter wachsen zu lassen. Wir sind stolz, mit euch gemeinsam Cubing-Geschichte in der Lausitz zu schreiben. Wir wünschen allen Teilnehmenden spannende Wettkämpfe, faire Duelle und vor allem viel Freude am Würfeln! items.name: Crazy Cubing Centurion 2023
items.information: Kick off the 2023 cubing season in Gauteng with a two day competition in Centurion. ### VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial" to be held at the start of Sunday. If you are a new competitor who is competing in any events on Saturday, please speak to a delegate who will show you how to compete and perform the above duties. We also recommend that you take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ### SPONSOR [CubeCo](https://cubeco.co.za/) is sponsoring this competition, and will be offering cubes for sale on the day. ### About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact). We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

items.information: Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. **Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!** **PLEASE NOTE:** This is a specialist competition. We do not recommend this competition to first time competitors. Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs above. PLEASE NOTE: For this competition, there will be a competitor limit of 16 for Multi-Blind on a first come first serve basis. If you register for Multi-Blind and are not within the first 16 people registered, your registration for the event will be removed. However we will be keeping a waiting list for this specific event in the case of dropouts before the competition. Please only consider registering for this event if you are certain you would like to compete in it. If you are competing in both [Crewe Favourites 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CreweFavourites2025) and [Crewe FMC Day 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CreweFMCDay2025), you'll be eligible for a £10 refund on your registration. For example, competing in one of the two competitions would cost you £20, and competing in both competitions would cost you £40 in registration fee upfront, but £30 in total, as you'll get £10 back after the competition. The winner of Fewest Moves will be announced as the winner of the competition. venue.details: Natjecanje će biti održano u sportskoj dvorani. / Competition will be held in the sports hall.

items.information: (HR) Croatian Championship 2024 je natjecanje koje se održava u Petrinji. Bilo tko može sudjelovati, bez obzira na nacionalnost i starost, no svatko mora biti upoznat s WCA Pravilnikom. Natjecanje je priznato kao Nacionalno Prvenstvo te će se dijeliti nagrade za najbolja 3 Hrvata u svim disciplinama. Za više informacija, proučite ostale kartice na stranici natjecanja. ---- (EN) Croatian Championship 2024 is a competition held in Petrinja. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations. This competition is recognized as Croatian National Championship and top 3 Croatians in all events will be additionally awarded, alongside regular podiums. For more information, check other tabs on the competition website.

items.name: Croatian Nationals 2019

venue.name: [Ekonomski fakultet u Osijeku](https://www.efos.unios.hr/)
venue.details: Natjecanje će biti održano u dvorani broj 3. / Competition will be held in the hall number 3.

items.information: (HR) Croatian Nationals 2019 je trinaesto natjecanje po redu koje se održava u Hrvatskoj od 2011. godine. Bilo tko može sudjelovati, bez obzira na nacionalnost i starost, no svatko mora biti upoznat s WCA Pravilnikom. Natjecanje je pod organizacijom Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Kotizacija pokriva trošak organizacije i najma prostora. Mogući višak kotizacije ide u svrhu razvitka Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Članovi Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska ostvaruju 25% popusta na kotizaciju. Također, natjecanje je priznato kao Nacionalno Prvenstvo te će se dijeliti nagrade za najbolja 3 Hrvata u svim disciplinama. -------------- (EN) Croatian Nationals 2019 is the 13th speedcubing competition being held in Croatia since 2011. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations. This competition is being organized by the Speedcubing Association Croatia. Registration fee covers the cost of the organization and venue rental. Any extra money goes directly to support Speedcubing Association Croatia. Members of Speedcubing Association Croatia have 25% discount on the registration fee. This competition is also recognized as Croatian National Championship and top 3 Croatians in all events will be additionally awarded, alongside regular podiums.

items.name: Croatian Quiet Championship 2026

venue.name: Microsoft Hrvatska
venue.details: Natjecanje će biti održano na 6. katu zgrade. / Competition will be held at the 6th floor.

items.information: (HR) Croatian Quiet Championship 2026 je natjecanje koje se održava u Zagrebu. Bilo tko može sudjelovati, bez obzira na nacionalnost i starost. Preporučujemo da budete upoznati s WCA Pravilnikom. Budući da se FMC i discipline slaganja naslijepo ne nalaze na [Croatian Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CroatianChampionship2026), ovo je Vaša prilika da postanete Hrvatski prvak u tim disciplinama. Nagrade za najbolja 3 hrvata će biti dodijeljene na svečanoj ceremoniji u Petrinji tjedan dana kasnije. *Ne morate se natjecati na Croatian Championshipu kako bi ste se natjecali na ovom natjecanju.* Za više informacija, proučite ostale kartice na stranici natjecanja. **NAPOMENA - NA OVOM NATJECANJU SE NEĆE ODRŽATI KLASIČNE DISCIPLINE KAO NPR. 3X3X3 KOCKA** (EN) Croatian Quiet Championship 2026 is a competition that will take place in Zagreb. Anyone may participate, regardless of nationality or age. We recommend that all competitors become familiar with the WCA Regulations. Since FMC and blindfolded events will not be held at [Croatian Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CroatianChampionship2026), this is your chance to become the Croatian champion in those events. Awards for the top 3 Croatian competitors will be presented at the ceremony in Petrinja one week later. *You do not have to compete at Croatian Championship to take part in this competition.* For more information, please check the other tabs on the competition page. **NOTE: THIS COMPETITION WILL NOT INCLUDE REGULAR EVENTS SUCH AS THE 3X3X3 CUBE.**

items.name: CuBeaulieu Craze 2024
items.information: ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## SPONSORSHIP ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzgyMjgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d1f95f10cca6c70419c1d2f0af053c637d4fdb6f/Cubestuff%20Small-Photoroom.jpg) A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za/) who will be the sponsor for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. ## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS Please be aware that we will likely run ahead of schedule throughout the weekend. Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time. ## NOTICE OF FILMING Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending. #### About CubingZA ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc4NzgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--32984d244f55e182cf16e089cf3f8466caffc2ac/image.png) CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, [please get in touch.](https://cubingza.org/contact)

items.information: Willkommen in der ehemaligen Hauptstadt – willkommen in Bonn! Zum allerersten Mal bringt ein Cubing-Turnier die Würfel-Community in diese traditionsreiche Stadt – und wir sind bereit, Geschichte zu schreiben. Freu dich auf ein Wochenende voller Spannung, persönlicher Bestzeiten, packender Finals und unvergesslicher Momente. Ob Newcomer oder Speedcubing-Profi – in Bonn wird gecubed, gefeiert und mitgefiebert! Sei dabei, wenn das erste Turnier in Bonn legendär wird. Melde dich jetzt an – wir können es kaum erwarten, dich dort zu sehen! Welcome to the former capital – welcome to Bonn! For the very first time, a cubing tournament is coming to this historic city – and we’re ready to make history together. Get ready for a weekend full of excitement, personal bests, thrilling finals, and unforgettable moments. Whether you’re a newcomer or a seasoned speedcuber – in Bonn, we cube, we cheer, and we celebrate! Be part of Bonn’s very first tournament and help us make it legendary. Sign up now – we can’t wait to see you there! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYzNzI4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6111d603a3f42ad9b696e4a64eecc2b9664c2245/image.png)

items.information: # Lưu ý: Giải đấu diễn ra vào ngày trong tuần (thứ Ba). Các thí sinh xin vui lòng lưu ý trước khi đăng ký tham dự. **Giải đấu này thuộc chuỗi giải đấu [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.cubeagainstcancer.org/), đồng hành với tổ chức [Ethan's Ohana](https://www.ethansohana.org/). Mỗi thí sinh xin vui lòng mang đến giải đấu ít nhất một khối Rubik 3x3 mới, chưa mở hộp hoặc một vật dụng khác liên quan đến STEM; các món quà này sẽ được trao tặng cho các bệnh nhi ung thư. Xin vui lòng xem thêm thông tin tại tab [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeAgainstCancerHanoi2026#69011-cube-against-cancer).** Lợi nhuận từ giải đấu này sẽ được đóng góp vào [Quỹ Ngày mai tươi sáng](https://ngaymaituoisang.vn/). -------------------------- # Note: This competition takes place on a weekday (Tuesday). Please keep this in mind before you make your registrations. **This competition is a part of the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.cubeagainstcancer.org/) competition series in collaboration with [Ethan's Ohana](https://www.ethansohana.org/). We are asking that all competitors bring at least one unopened 3x3 cube or STEM-related item, which will be donated to a pediatric cancer patient. See the [Cube Against Cancer](Insert link here) tab for more information.** Proceeds from this competition will be donated to the [Ngày mai tươi sáng Charity Fund](https://ngaymaituoisang.vn/).

items.name: CubeCo Coastal Cubing KZN 2025
items.information: **Durban’s First 2-Day Cubing Competition in Over Two Years!** Join us for an action-packed weekend of speedcubing on March 21st & 22nd! Day 1 (Friday) falls on Human Rights Day, making it the perfect opportunity to challenge yourself with events you don't always see - like Clock, Megaminx, and even 3x3 Blindfolded! If you're looking to try something new, this is your chance. Day 2 (Saturday) is all about the fan favorites: Pyraminx, 2x2, and a full three rounds of 3x3. Whether you're a seasoned competitor or brand new to WCA events, there's something for you. New to competing? No problem! We'll have a newcomer tutorial to walk you through competing and judging (yes, even first-timers help with judging). Just remember to bring a form of ID for registration. While most beginner-friendly events happen on Saturday, you're absolutely welcome to compete on Friday too! Don't miss out - come test your skills, meet fellow cubers, and be part of Durban's cubing community!

venue.name: [PIB](https://https://www.facebook.com/pibdesamparados/)
venue.address: 100 metros Oeste de la Plaza de deportes, Desamparados, Costa Rica

items.information: **Cube Factory Masters 2023** Nueva competencia para el año 2023. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia official de la World Cube Association. La competencia es abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, el registro esta habilitado desde la página oficial de la WCA. No es necesario tener experiencia, pero los competidores deben conocer los Reglamentos El acceso a invitados y espectadores será gratuita. _____ **English version** **Cube Factory Masters Desmaparados 2023** Is a new speedcubing competition of the year 2023. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. The competition is open to all competitors of all nationalities. Registration is available on the WCA website. No experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA Regulations The competition is free to spectators and guests.
